author: Williamsburg Sun
title: Arlington County Board approves Fiscal Year 2027 Capital Improvement Plan
text:
Arlington County Board approves Fiscal Year 2027 Capital Improvement Plan
The Arlington County Board has approved the Fiscal Year 2027 Capital Improvement Plan (CIP), a 10-year strategy for building, maintaining, upgrading, or replacing county facilities and infrastructure, on July 23. The CIP is prepared every two years and is designed to guide long-term investments across Arlington.
According to Arlington County, "Prepared every 2 years, the CIP is the County’s 10-year plan for building, maintaining, upgrading or replacing County facilities and infrastructure. Give us 2 minutes to see how it all works and what this means for our community."
In addition to the CIP, Arlington residents are invited to participate in several upcoming community events and feedback opportunities. The Arlington County Fair is accepting registrations for its Competitive Exhibits, which allow participants to showcase artistic works, agricultural achievements, and culinary creations. Registration is currently open for those interested in competing for ribbons at the fair, according to Arlington County Fair Inc.
On August 1, visitors can attend Dark Star Park Day at Arlington’s first county-commissioned public artwork. The event features a unique shadow alignment that occurs once a year at the 0.4-acre park. Community members are also encouraged to provide feedback on Arlington's 2027 Legislative Package, the Permanent Supportive Housing Landlord Satisfaction Survey, and proposed impervious area limits for residential neighborhoods. Feedback forms for these initiatives are open through July 31, with some transportation project surveys available until August 2.
The county has also released its new $1.7 billion balanced budget for Fiscal Year 2027, with infographics available to help residents understand the details. Arlington County has once again been ranked among the top digital counties in the country for 2026, according to Arlington County. Early voting for the August 4, 2026 Dual Primary Election is available at three locations for all Arlington voters.
Residents are reminded that 99% of people in Arlington live within a 10-minute walk of a park, and the county encourages community members to enjoy local green spaces during the summer months.
